+theorem pair_absent {xs : List Nat} {a b : Nat} (ha : a ∉ xs) :
+    pairCount xs a b = 0 := by
+  unfold pairCount
+  have empty : (subsetsOf xs).filter

+    apply List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr

+    pairCount xs a b = 2 ^ (xs.length - 2) := by

+    by_cases hax : a = x
